## [1.1.0-dev.7](https://github.com/[secure]/morphe-patches/compare/v1.1.0-dev.6...v1.1.0-dev.7) (2026-11-03)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **iap:** relax ELF header parsing in full bypass patch ([c8e8f1a](https://github.com/[secure]/morphe-patches/commit/c8e8f1a1e0723bea675549d48acb97114a8d1e5e))

patches.name: Cheats Screen Unlock
patches.description: Makes the in-game Cheats screen reachable by redirecting the Settings -> Credits button to SystemScreen.OpenCheats. Single-player UI only; it does not grant items, currency, or purchases.

options.description: Patch SystemScreen.OpenCredits to jump to SystemScreen.OpenCheats. The Credits button then opens the Cheats panel. Disabled by default.

patches.name: IAP Bypass Patch
patches.description: Mocks PlayFab Catalog API for IAP fulfillment without platform billing.

patches.name: IAP Free (All Items)
patches.description: Makes all in-game store purchases free by bypassing the PlayFab server and Play Store UI. Patches IAPService.PurchaseBundle to return immediately without calling IStoreController.InitiatePurchase, and patches StoreService.PurchaseItem for in-game store purchases.

options.description: Patch IAPService.PurchaseBundle and StoreService.PurchaseItem to bypass the PlayFab server and Play Store UI. Purchases are registered but not automatically granted. Disabled by default.

patches.name: IAP Full Bypass
patches.description: Bypasses PlayFab validation and grants items locally, setting price to free.

options.description: If false, the patch is inactive.

patches.name: IAP Native Probe
patches.description: Read-only diagnostics for libil2cpp.so: hashes the library and checks whether the KoPP2 2.21.4 PurchaseItem and IAP grant-function offsets are reachable in both ABIs.

options.description: Append one harmless byte to libil2cpp.so so the patcher has to rewrite and re-align the native-library entry. Disabled by default; enable only to verify the extract -> edit -> rebuild -> install pipeline.

patches.name: Native Method Patch Demo
patches.description: Replaces the harmless CheatsScreen.ShowCheatAlert method with an immediate return in both libil2cpp.so ABIs. Demonstrates static ELF RVA mapping and byte patching; it does not touch billing, purchases, entitlements, or networking.

options.description: Replace CheatsScreen.ShowCheatAlert with an immediate return. This is a harmless UI alert, not billing or purchase code. Disabled by default.

patches.name: Native Visual Feedback
patches.description: Hooks every probed purchase and PlayFab method in libil2cpp.so and logs "CALLED: <method>" through NGUIDebug's on-screen overlay. Diagnostic only; it does not change any return value, response, entitlement, or purchase result.

options.description: Install diagnostic hooks for the probed purchase and PlayFab methods. The hooks only log; they do not alter return values or purchases. Disabled by default.

patches.name: On-screen Game Log
patches.description: Adds a touch-through, auto-scrolling log panel over the lower 30% of the screen, with padding from the screen edges. It shows this process's logcat output (Unity Debug.Log, native and Java logs). Diagnostic only; no game state is changed.
